content.scenario: The Central Government wants to provide an alternative dispute resolution mechanism for consumer complaints. It needs to set up a dedicated cell to handle mediation.
content.outcome: The Central Government shall establish a consumer mediation cell by notification, to be attached to the National Commission and each of the regional Benches. This cell will provide a platform for consumer mediation and alternative dispute resolution.

user_queries: What is the purpose of the consumer mediation cell?
How will the Central Government establish the consumer mediation cell?
What are the benefits of consumer mediation?
